article.title: Mark Wahlberg wants to take on the longevity-startup crowd with an affordable gym concept
article.summary: Mark Wahlberg, who once sank money into a gym chain that got kicked off the NYSE, is now building his own, and he promises you’ll get a cold plunge, a blood panel and a protein muffin without needing a trust fund.
